name: Deep Work
description: Music for working, reading and thinking: quiet dynamics, long chord cycles, gentle ambient beds and seeded, generative parts that never repeat in quite the same way. Nothing sudden, nothing that asks for your attention. Change the Seed box for a fresh take.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Library Hours
sketches.description: The hush of a big reading room: a slow clock, warm chords and a sparse piano that never plays the same phrase twice.
sketches.source:
setcpm(60/4)

// The hush of a big reading room: soft brown noise and a slow clock
air: s("brown").slow(8).lpf(600).gain(.08)
clock: s("tick*2").lpf(4000).pan(.7).gain(.1)

// Sparse piano: a few seeded notes from the pentatonic, never the same twice
piano: n(irand(8).segment(4)).scale("D:minor pentatonic").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.5).seed("library")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.005).decay(1.2).sustain(.1).release(1.5)
  .room(.6).size(.8).gain(.28)

// Warm chords, two bars each: Fmaj7, Dm9, Bbmaj7, Cadd9
chords: note("<[f3,a3,c4,e4] [d3,f3,a3,e4] [bb2,d3,f3,a3] [c3,e3,g3,d4]>").slow(2)
  .s("sine").fm(.6).fmh(2)
  .attack(1).release(3).lpf(1400).room(.7).gain(.2)

// Now and then a chair creaks in the next aisle
chair: s("~ ~ ~ creak").mask("<0 0 1 0 0 0 0 1>").occlude(.5).gain(.12)

sketches.name: Deep Focus
sketches.description: A filtered brown-noise bed, a low fifth that barely moves and a pad that opens over minutes. A distant bell marks every sixteen bars.
sketches.source:
setcpm(50/4)

// Brown noise, gently filtered so it never hisses
noise: s("brown").slow(8).lpf(sine.range(300, 700).slow(32)).gain(.18)

// A low open fifth that barely moves
drone: note("<[c2,g2] [c2,g2] [ab1,eb2] [bb1,f2]>").slow(4)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.15)
  .lpf(500).attack(4).sustain(1).release(6).gain(.18)

// A wide pad, opening and closing over minutes
pad: note("<[eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [eb3,g3,c4,d4] [c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [d3,f3,bb3,c4]>").slow(4)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3)
  .lpf(sine.range(400, 1400).slow(48)).attack(4).release(6)
  .room(.8).size(.95).gain(.12)

// A distant bell every sixteen bars
bell: note("<g4 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~>").s("sine").fm(3).fmh(2.76)
  .decay(5).sustain(0).release(5).room(.9).size(.95).gain(.1)

sketches.name: Café Corner
sketches.description: A corner table: the murmur of the room, a brushed and swung kit, jazz voicings, a walking bass and a vibraphone that leaves plenty of space.
sketches.source:
setcpm(84/4)

// The murmur of a café
crowd: s("crowd").slow(8).intensity(.3).gain(.12)

// Brushed kit, lazily swung and rolled off
drums: s("bd ~ ~ bd, ~ rim ~ rim, hh*8").swing(4).lpf(4000).gain(.38)

// Jazz piano voicings: Dm9, G13, Cmaj9, A7
keys: note("<[f3,a3,c4,e4] [f3,b3,e4,a4] [e3,g3,b3,d4] [g3,c#4,e4,g4]>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ [~ x] ~ x ~ ~")
  .s("sine").fm(1.1).fmh(2)
  .decay(.8).sustain(.3).release(.6).lpf(2400).room(.4).gain(.28)

// Walking upright bass
bass: note("<[d2 f2 a2 c3] [g1 b1 d2 f2] [c2 e2 g2 b2] [a1 c#2 e2 g2]>")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.4).sustain(.3).release(.15).gain(.48)

// A vibraphone wandering the changes, forgetting a note now and then
vibes: n("~ [4 ~ 2] ~ 1 ~ ~ [0 2] ~").scale("D:dorian").transpose(12)
  .every(3, rev).degradeBy(.3).seed("cafe")
  .s("sine").fm(2).fmh(4).decay(.6).sustain(0).release(.8)
  .delay(.25).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Rain on the Skylight
sketches.description: Steady rain and stray drips overhead, a felt piano rolling slow broken chords and a cello holding the roots.
sketches.source:
setcpm(64/4)

// Rain overhead and a few drips nearby
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.5).gain(.3)
drips: s("drip*8?0.7").pan(rand).gain(rand.range(.05, .15)).space("room")

// Felt piano: slow broken chords through Am, F, C, G
piano: note("<[a2 e3 a3 c4 e4 c4 a3 e3] [f2 c3 f3 a3 c4 a3 f3 c3] [c3 g3 c4 e4 g4 e4 c4 g3] [g2 d3 g3 b3 d4 b3 g3 d3]>").slow(2)
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.01).decay(1).sustain(.1).release(1.4)
  .lpf(1600).room(.6).size(.8).gain(.3)

// A cello holds the roots
cello: note("<a2 f2 c3 g2>").slow(2).s("sawtooth").vib(4.5).vibdepth(.08)
  .lpf(700).attack(.8).sustain(.7).release(1.5).room(.5).gain(.18)

sketches.name: Fireside Reading
sketches.description: A crackling fire, folk guitar picking in G, a low cello, a mantel clock and a distant whistle that comes and goes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(70/4)

// The fire
fire: s("fire").slow(4).intensity(.4).density(10).gain(.3)

// Guitar picking a slow folk pattern: G, Em, C, D
guitar: note("<[g2 d3 g3 b3 d4 b3 g3 d3] [e2 b2 e3 g3 b3 g3 e3 b2] [c3 g3 c4 e4 g4 e4 c4 g3] [d3 a3 d4 f#4 a4 f#4 d4 a3]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright")
  .attack(.002).decay(.5).sustain(0).release(.5)
  .lpf(2600).pan(.4).room(.4).gain(.3)

// A low cello under the guitar
cello: note("<g2 e2 c2 d2>").s("sawtooth").vib(4.5).vibdepth(.08)
  .lpf(600).attack(.6).sustain(.6).release(1.2).room(.5).gain(.18)

// A soft whistle, far away, every other phrase
whistle: note("<[d5@3 b4] [g4@4] [e5@2 d5 c5] [a4@4]>").mask("<0 0 0 0 1 1 1 1>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(5).vibdepth(.1)
  .attack(.2).sustain(.6).release(1).pan(.65).room(.6).gain(.16)

// The clock on the mantelpiece
clock: s("tick ~ tick ~").pan(.25).gain(.08)

sketches.name: Tidal Writing
sketches.description: A desk by the sea: surf and a light wind, a pad that rises and falls like the swell, a glassy motif in the echoes and a far-off gull.
sketches.source:
setcpm(56/4)

// Waves and a light wind
surf: s("surf").slow(8).intensity(.4).gain(.3)
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.2).gain(.06)

// A slow pad in D, rising and falling like the swell
pad: note("<[d3,a3,e4,f#4] [b2,f#3,d4,a4] [g2,d3,b3,f#4] [a2,e3,c#4,e4]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.25)
  .lpf(sine.range(500, 1600).slow(16)).attack(2).release(4)
  .room(.8).size(.9).gain(.14)

// A glassy motif drifting through the echoes
glass: n("<[0 ~ 4 ~] [~ 2 ~ ~] [7 ~ ~ 4] [~ ~ 2 ~]>").scale("D:major").transpose(12)
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(.5).sustain(0).release(1)
  .pan(sine.slow(8)).delay(.45).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.5).room(.6).gain(.2)

// A gull, far off to the left
gull: s("bird").slow(4).azimuth(-70).distance(8).gain(.12)

sketches.name: Thought Garden
sketches.description: Generative piano: two hands improvise from the same pentatonic scale, each with its own seed, over a soft held fifth. Change the seed for a new take.
sketches.source:
setcpm(72/4)

// Two hands improvise from the same scale, each with its own seed
right: n(irand(10).segment(8)).scale("E:minor pentatonic").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.55).seed("think-1")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.005).decay(1).sustain(.05).release(1.2)
  .pan(.6).room(.6).size(.8).gain(.26)
left: n(irand(5).segment(2)).scale("E:minor pentatonic").transpose(-12)
  .degradeBy(.3).seed("think-2")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.005).decay(1.5).sustain(.1).release(1.5)
  .pan(.4).room(.6).size(.8).gain(.24)

// A soft held fifth keeps the key
drone: note("[e2,b2]").slow(8).s("sine").attack(3).sustain(1).release(4).gain(.15)

sketches.name: Flow State
sketches.description: A soft, steady beat for heads-down work: a muted kick, drifting hats, a round bass and a delayed arpeggio over Am, F, C, G, two bars each.
sketches.source:
setcpm(90/4)

// A soft, steady kit way back in the mix
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~").lpf(200).gain(.5),
  s("~ ~ rim ~").room(.3).gain(.18),
  s("hh*8").hpf(8000).gain(perlin.range(.05, .15))
)

// Round bass on the roots, two bars per chord
bass: note("<a1 f1 c2 g1>").slow(2).struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~")
  .s("sine").shape(.1).decay(.4).sustain(.3).release(.2).gain(.45)

// An arpeggio in the delay keeps time without asking for attention
arp: n("[0 2 4 2]*2").add("<0 0 5 5 2 2 6 6>").scale("A:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("square").pw(.3).lpf(1600).decay(.1).sustain(0)
  .delay(.35).delaytime(3/16).delayfeedback(.35).gain(.1)

// A pad holding the chords
pad: note("<[a3,c4,e4] [f3,a3,c4] [c4,e4,g4] [g3,b3,d4]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.25)
  .attack(1).release(2).lpf(1200).room(.6).gain(.14)

sketches.name: Midnight Terminal
sketches.description: Late-night coding: a slow filtered sequence in C minor, a deep pad and sub, a quiet kit and the hum of the server room behind you.
sketches.source:
setcpm(80/4)

// A quiet electronic kit
drums: s("bd ~ ~ ~, ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ rim ~, [~ hh]*4").lpf(3000).room(.3).gain(.32)

// A slow sequence through Cm, Ab, Fm, Gm, two bars each
seq: n("0 2 4 2 7 4 2 4").add("<0 0 -2 -2 -4 -4 -3 -3>").scale("C:minor")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(500, 1800).slow(16)).lpq(4).decay(.15).sustain(0)
  .pan(.4).delay(.35).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.4).gain(.15)

// A deep pad and sub bass
pad: note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3)
  .attack(2).release(3).lpf(1000).room(.8).size(.9).gain(.14)
sub: note("<c2 ab1 f1 g1>").slow(2).s("sine").attack(.5).sustain(.8).release(1).gain(.35)

// The hum of the server room, somewhere behind you
hum: s("engine").slow(8).azimuth(180).distance(5).gain(.1)

sketches.name: Thinking in Circles
sketches.description: Three marimba figures of five, six and seven notes share one step size, so they only line up again every 210 steps, over two slow string chords.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/4)

// Figures of five, six and seven notes share one step size,
// so they line up again only every 210 steps
m1: note("{a3 c4 e4 g4 e4}%8").s("sine").fm(.6).fmh(4).decay(.35).sustain(0)
  .pan(.3).room(.4).gain(.22)
m2: note("{e4 g4 a4 c5 a4 g4}%8").s("sine").fm(.6).fmh(4).decay(.35).sustain(0)
  .pan(.7).room(.4).gain(.18)
m3: note("{c5 ~ d5 e5 ~ g5 ~}%8").s("sine").fm(.6).fmh(4).decay(.3).sustain(0)
  .room(.5).delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).gain(.13)

// Low strings on two slow chords
strings: note("<[a2,e3,c4] [f2,c3,a3]>").slow(4)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.15).lpf(900)
  .attack(2).release(3).room(.6).gain(.14)
bass: note("<a1 f1>").slow(4).s("sine").attack(.5).sustain(.8).release(1).gain(.3)

sketches.name: Night Train
sketches.description: A book on a night train: the engine rumble, wheels over rail joints, rain on the window and an electric piano watching the lights go by.
sketches.source:
setcpm(76/4)

// The carriage: a low rumble and wheels over rail joints
engine: s("engine").slow(8).lpf(800).gain(.15)
rails: s("[lt ~ lt ~] ~ ~ ~").speed(.8).lpf(400).gain(.25)

// Rain streaking the window, heard through the glass
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.25).occlude(.6).gain(.18)

// Electric piano: Ebmaj7, Cm9, Abmaj7, Bb6
keys: note("<[eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [c3,eb3,g3,d4] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,g3]>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~")
  .s("sine").fm(1.1).fmh(2)
  .decay(1).sustain(.3).release(1).lpf(2000).room(.5).gain(.28)

// Bass, and a passing melody that comes and goes
bass: note("<eb2 c2 ab1 bb1>").s("sine").shape(.1).decay(.6).sustain(.4).release(.4).gain(.45)
melody: n("<[4@3 2] [3@2 2 1] [0@4] [1 2 4@2]>").scale("C:minor").transpose(12)
  .mask("<1 1 1 1 0 0 0 0>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(.5).sustain(.2).release(1)
  .delay(.35).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Noise Shelter
sketches.description: Nothing tonal at all: brown and pink noise drifting slowly under light rain, so the ear never fixes on one sound. A wall against open-plan chatter.
sketches.source:
setcpm(60/4)

// Three colours of noise, each drifting slowly so the ear never fixes on one
brown: s("brown").slow(8).lpf(sine.range(250, 600).slow(40)).gain(.22)
pink: s("pink").slow(8).hpf(200).lpf(sine.range(800, 2000).slow(56)).pan(sine.slow(30)).gain(.06)
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.2).gain(.12)
